title: thymus zygis var. serpylloides
intro: Thymus zygis var. serpylloides, commonly known as Spanish Thyme, is a perennial plant in the mint family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Spanish Thyme are attributed to its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which help to combat infections and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Spanish Thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and other essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its characteristic aroma and flavor.
